question: Who among the following persons secured the fourth position in the Dhaka Marathon 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jigmet Dolma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's Jigmet Dolma **finished fourth in the Dhaka Marathon 2021.
 
• SPO Jigmet Dolma is a Ladakh police officer. The marathon was held to celebrate Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's homecoming to Bangladesh from a Pakistani jail in 1972.
 
• In the full marathon, Bahadur Singh of India took first place in the men's category and Pushpa Bhandari of Nepal took first place in the women's category among SAARC and local runners.
 
• Hicham Lakohi of Morocco won the elite competition of the marathon in the men's division, while Angela Jim Asunde of Kenya took first place in the women's category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The marathon was held to celebrate Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's homecoming to Bangladesh from a Pakistani jail in 1972.
 
• The full marathon was 42.19 kilometers long, while the half marathon was 21.09 kilometers long.
